business_problem: Nikao needed specialized engineering capacity to develop fintech services and address fragmented customer data. It wanted customers to self-serve against personal financial information while keeping centralized data governed and secure.
solution_summary: Nikao Technology incorporated AI into its development process to accelerate selected solutions and automate quality-assurance testing, working with DXC engineering teams for specialist fintech expertise and scalable delivery. Nikao describes centralizing fragmented organizational data, applying governance and security, and exposing appropriate information to external customers. AI and agentic solutions then let customers ask questions about their own data and receive quick responses through self-service. One cited application is a retail-banking journey where customers can choose investments such as ISAs, GICs, and pension funds. The source does not identify model, cloud, database, or application products, and it does not describe the data-processing architecture in greater detail.
data_flow: Nikao centralizes fragmented organizational data, applies governance and security, and exposes customer-specific information to AI and agentic self-service solutions that answer customer questions.
business_outcome: Nikao says AI accelerates engineering work and enables customers to self-serve and interrogate personal data securely; no quantified operational outcome is reported.
architecture_clues: AI is also used in software development and quality-assurance testing
